svg.title: KBMesh — animated architecture
svg.desc: Knowledge flows up from sources through the ingest pipeline into the knowledge mesh, where AI agents retrieve and answer for users. Governance rail and model layer support the stack.
svg.text: Knowledge flows up from sources, through the mesh, into AI agents that answer your team — with PII guardrails throughout.
On-premise perimeter — nothing leaves the company network without approval

g.text: Every document chunked into meaning-rich pieces.
Semantic search across millions of passages.
"A depends on B", "policy X supersedes Y".
Answers "what breaks if I delete this?"

svg.text: Read top → bottom: raw documents enter at the top, are cleaned and indexed in the middle, become cited answers for users at the bottom.
